name: Serif
description: A slab-serif stem: one upright with a foot and a head, turned to whichever way the line runs.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(10% 0, 90% 0, 90% 18%, 62% 18%, 62% 82%, 90% 82%, 90% 100%, 10% 100%, 10% 82%, 38% 82%, 38% 18%, 10% 18%); clip-path: polygon(10% 0, 90% 0, 90% 18%, 62% 18%, 62% 82%, 90% 82%, 90% 100%, 10% 100%, 10% 82%, 38% 82%, 38% 18%, 10% 18%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
